description:
CARRIAGE BOLTS M10 X 100MM, GALVANISED STEEL
What it is: Galvanised steel carriage bolts, 10mm in diameter and 100mm long, which are finished products used for fastening wood to wood or wood to metal.
reason: Carriage bolts are specifically mentioned in heading 7318, which covers screws, bolts, nuts, and similar articles of iron or steel.
